newsitem.title: USA: Spieker Properties buys West Coast buildings.
newsitem.headline: Spieker Properties buys West Coast buildings.

text.p: Spieker Properties Inc said it completed during the first quarter of 1997 the previously announced purchase of 261,000 square feet of office space on the West Coast.

The company said it completed the purchase of Riverside Center, a 99,000 square foot, five-story office building in Portland, Ore., and the Fountaingrove Office Complex, a three-building, 162,000 square foot property in northern California.
Spieker said it identified these properties as pending acquisitions in the prospectus for its January 1997 equity offering.
Spieker said these acquisitions bring its total investments for the first quarter to $407.8 million, representing 3.2 million rentable square feet.
Spieker owns and operates more than 24.9 million square feet of suburban commercial property in California and the Pacific Northwest.
